about.description: Junior full-stack developer combining formal computer science education with hands-on web engineering and practical networking foundation.
about.p1: I am a junior full-stack developer and Computer Science student at Jimma University (2023–2027), based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
about.p2: I build digital products that solve real problems, spanning web applications, API-connected platforms, and technical tools. My foundation is built on practical software engineering complemented by hands-on networking experience—including configuring IP cameras, installing and maintaining Wi-Fi networks, and working with MikroTik and Cisco switches.
about.p3: I am fluent in Amharic (Native), Afaan Oromo (Native), and English (Professional working). My focus centers on writing clean, defensive code and steadily expanding into application security.
